;Arts and culture

**The [[Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences]] announces new changes to the [[Academy Awards|Oscars]], including possibly a shorter ceremony, and a new category called "Most Popular Film". ;Disasters and accidents
*[[August 2018 Lombok earthquake]]
**The death toll from the magnitude 6.9 [[earthquake]] in [[Lombok]], [[Indonesia]], rises to 131 and nearly 2,500 people are now confirmed seriously injured. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/amphtml/world/asia_pacific/the-latest-death-toll-rises-to-131-in-indonesian-quake/2018/08/08/3c50ed96-9ad8-11e8-a8d8-9b4c13286d6b_story.html?noredirect=on (''The Washington Post'')]

;International relations
*[[Canada–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**[[Saudi Press Agency]] reports that all Saudi patients are being transferred from Canadian hospitals to other medical facilities outside Canada. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/saudi-arabia-halts-medical-treatment-citizens-canada-180808060116922.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Colombia–United States relations]], [[Crisis in Venezuela (2012–present)]]
**The [[United States]] pledges [[US$]]9 million in aid to [[Colombia]] to help support [[Venezuela]]n migrants in the country. [https://www.mcclatchydc.com/news/nation-world/world/article216251375.html (McClatchy DC Bureau)]
*[[2018 China–United States trade war]]
**[[China]] announces 25% [[tariff]]s on an additional US$16 billion worth of imports from the United States, effective August 23, matching yesterday's decision by the United States. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-08/china-to-match-u-s-tariffs-on-16b-of-imports-from-aug-23 (Bloomberg)]
*[[International recognition of the State of Palestine]]
**The Mission of Palestine in [[Colombia]] announces recognition of the [[State of Palestine]] as a free and sovereign state. [http://english.wafa.ps/page.aspx?id=B9sZ6Ea98732952714aB9sZ6E (WAFA)]
*Reactions to the [[poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
**The United States imposes new sanctions on [[Russia]] after the use of a [[Novichok agent|Novichok nerve agent]] in the [[United Kingdom]]. Yesterday, the UK said that they would seek extradition of suspects from Russia. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-45122723 (BBC)] [https://news.sky.com/story/uk-to-seek-extradition-of-two-russian-suspects-in-novichok-attacks-sky-sources-11463507 (Sky News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] reports the execution and crucifixion, in [[Mecca]], of a man from [[Myanmar]]. The man was sentenced for breaking into the home of a woman and stabbing her, which led to her death, as well as for other crimes. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-08/saudi-arabia-carries-out-rare-crucifixion-for-murder-theft (Bloomberg)]
*[[Insider trading]]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] [[Chris Collins (New York politician)|Chris Collins]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]–[[New York's 27th congressional district|NY]]) is arrested on charges of [[Securities fraud|securities]] and [[Mail and wire fraud|wire fraud]], [[Conspiracy (criminal)|conspiracy]] and [[Making false statements|lying to investigators]]. He is accused of passing nonpublic information about [[Innate Immunotherapeutics]], a biotech company, to his son, who traded on the information and passed it along to others. Collins was a director of the company and also a major investor. [https://www.npr.org/2018/08/08/636666323/new-york-congressman-indicted-on-insider-trading-charges (NPR)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Slovenia]]
**Five center-left political parties nominate [[Marjan Šarec]] to become [[Prime Minister of Slovenia]]. [http://www.euronews.com/2018/08/08/slovenias-centre-left-coalition-nominates-marjan-sarec-for-pm (Euronews)]
